   197→def sync_unscored_dimensions(
   198→    plan: PlanModel,
   199→    state: StateModel,
   200→) -> UnscoredDimensionSyncResult:
   201→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions.
   202→
   203→    1. **Prune** — remove ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are
   204→       no longer unscored AND not stale (avoids pruning stale IDs — that is
   205→       ``sync_stale_dimensions``' responsibility).
   206→    2. **Inject** — unconditionally prepend currently-unscored IDs to the
   207→       *front* of ``queue_order`` so initial reviews are the first priority.
   208→    """
   209→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   210→    result = UnscoredDimensionSyncResult()
   211→    unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   212→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   213→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   214→
   215→    # --- Cleanup: prune subjective IDs that are no longer unscored --------
   216→    # Only prune IDs that are neither unscored nor stale (stale sync owns those).
   217→    to_remove: list[str] = [
   218→        fid for fid in order
   219→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   220→        and fid not in unscored_ids
   221→        and fid not in stale_ids
   222→    ]
   223→    for fid in to_remove:
   224→        order.remove(fid)
   225→        result.pruned.append(fid)
   226→
   227→    # --- Inject: prepend unscored IDs after any promoted items -------------
   228→    existing = set(order)
   229→    insert_at = _after_promoted(order, plan)
   230→    for uid in reversed(sorted(unscored_ids)):
   231→        if uid not in existing:
   232→            order.insert(insert_at, uid)
   233→            result.injected.append(uid)
   234→
   235→    return result

   250→       ``sync_unscored_dimensions``).
   251→    2. If no objective items remain after cleanup, inject all currently-stale
   252→       dimension IDs so the plan surfaces them as actionable work.
   253→    """
   254→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   255→    result = StaleDimensionSyncResult()
   256→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   257→    unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   258→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   259→
   260→    # --- Cleanup: prune resolved subjective IDs --------------------------
   261→    # Only prune IDs that are neither stale nor unscored.
   262→    to_remove: list[str] = [
   263→        fid for fid in order
   264→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   265→        and fid not in stale_ids
   266→        and fid not in unscored_ids
   267→    ]
   268→    for fid in to_remove:
   269→        order.remove(fid)
   270→        result.pruned.append(fid)
   271→
   272→    # --- Inject: populate when no objective items remain -----------------
   273→    has_real_items = any(fid for fid in order if not fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX))
   274→    if not has_real_items and stale_ids:
   275→        existing = set(order)
   276→        for sid in sorted(stale_ids):
   277→            if sid not in existing:
   278→                order.append(sid)
   279→                result.injected.append(sid)
   280→
   281→    return result
   282→
   283→
   284→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   285→# Triage snapshot hash + sync
   286→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   287→
   288→def review_finding_snapshot_hash(state: StateModel) -> str:
   289→    """Hash open review finding IDs to detect changes.
   290→
   291→    Returns empty string when there are no open review findings.
   292→    """
   293→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   294→    review_ids = sorted(
   295→        fid for fid, f in findings.items()
   296→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   297→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   298→    )
   299→    if not review_ids:
   300→        return ""
   301→    return hashlib.sha256("|".join(review_ids).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
   302→
   303→
   304→@dataclass
   305→class TriageSyncResult:
   306→    """What changed during a triage sync."""
   307→
   308→    injected: bool = False
   309→    pruned: bool = False
   310→
   311→    @property
   312→    def changes(self) -> int:
   313→        return int(self.injected) + int(self.pruned)
   314→
   315→
   316→def sync_triage_needed(
   317→    plan: PlanModel,
   318→    state: StateModel,
   319→) -> TriageSyncResult:
   320→    """Inject 4 triage stage IDs at front of queue when review findings change.
   321→
   322→    Only injects stages not already confirmed in ``epic_triage_meta``.
   323→    Never auto-prunes — only explicit completion removes them.
   324→    """
   325→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   326→    result = TriageSyncResult()
   327→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   328→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   329→    confirmed = set(meta.get("triage_stages", {}).keys())
   330→
   331→    # Check if any triage stage is already in queue
   332→    already_present = any(sid in order for sid in TRIAGE_IDS)
   333→
   334→    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
   335→    last_hash = meta.get("finding_snapshot_hash", "")
   336→
   337→    # If hash changed and no stages present, inject unconfirmed stages
   338→    if current_hash and current_hash != last_hash and not already_present:
   339→        insert_at = _after_promoted(order, plan)
   340→        stage_names = ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "commit")
   341→        existing = set(order)
   342→        injected_count = 0
   343→        for sid, name in zip(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS, stage_names):
   344→            if name not in confirmed and sid not in existing:
   345→                order.insert(insert_at + injected_count, sid)
   346→                injected_count += 1
   347→        if injected_count:
   348→            result.injected = True
   349→
   350→    return result
   351→
   352→
   353→@dataclass
   354→class CreatePlanSyncResult:
   355→    """What changed during a create-plan sync."""
   356→
   357→    injected: bool = False
   358→
   359→    @property
   360→    def changes(self) -> int:
   361→        return int(self.injected)
   362→
   363→
   364→def sync_create_plan_needed(
   365→    plan: PlanModel,
   366→    state: StateModel,
   367→) -> CreatePlanSyncResult:
   368→    """Inject ``workflow::create-plan`` when reviews complete + objective backlog exists.
   369→
   370→    Only injects when:
   371→    - No unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions remain
   372→    - At least one objective finding exists
   373→    - ``workflow::create-plan`` is not already in the queue
   374→    - No triage stages are pending
   375→    """
   376→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   377→    result = CreatePlanSyncResult()
   378→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   379→
   380→    if WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID in order:
   381→        return result
   382→
   383→    # Don't inject if triage stages are pending
   384→    if any(sid in order for sid in TRIAGE_IDS):
   385→        return result
   386→
   387→    # Check that no unscored dimensions remain
   388→    unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
   389→    if unscored:
   390→        return result
   391→
   392→    # Check that objective findings exist
   393→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   394→    has_objective = any(
   395→        f.get("status") == "open"
   396→        and f.get("detector") not in ("review", "concerns", "subjective_review", "subjective_assessment")
   397→        for f in findings.values()
   398→    )
   399→    if not has_objective:
   400→        return result
   401→
   402→    # Insert after any subjective items, before findings
   403→    insert_at = 0
   404→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   405→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX) or fid.startswith(TRIAGE_PREFIX):
   406→            insert_at = i + 1
   407→    order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID)
   408→    result.injected = True
   409→    return result
   410→
   411→
   412→def compute_new_finding_ids(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
   413→    """Return the set of open review/concerns finding IDs added since last triage.
   414→
   415→    Returns an empty set when no prior triage has recorded ``triaged_ids``.
   416→    """
   417→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   418→    triaged = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", meta.get("synthesized_ids", [])))
   419→    current = {
   420→        fid for fid, f in state.get("findings", {}).items()
   421→        if f.get("status") == "open" and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   422→    }
   423→    return current - triaged if triaged else set()
   424→
   425→
   426→def is_triage_stale(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> bool:
   427→    """Side-effect-free check: is triage needed?
   428→
   429→    Returns True when any ``triage::*`` stage ID is in the queue OR the
   430→    review-finding snapshot hash has drifted from the last completed triage.
   431→    """
   432→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   433→    order = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   434→    if order & TRIAGE_IDS:
   435→        return True
   436→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   437→    last_hash = meta.get("finding_snapshot_hash", "")
   438→    if not last_hash:
   439→        return False
   440→    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
   441→    return bool(current_hash and current_hash != last_hash)
   442→
   443→
   444→
   445→__all__ = [
   446→    "SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX",
   447→    "TRIAGE_ID",
   448→    "TRIAGE_IDS",
   449→    "TRIAGE_PREFIX",
   450→    "TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS",
   451→    "SYNTHETIC_PREFIXES",
   452→    "WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID",
   453→    "WORKFLOW_PREFIX",
   454→    "CreatePlanSyncResult",

    22→def enrich_with_impact(items: list[dict], dimension_scores: dict) -> None:
    23→    """Stamp ``estimated_impact`` on each item based on dimension-level headroom.
    24→
    25→    Impact = ``overall_per_point * headroom`` where headroom = ``100 - score``.
    26→    Items in dimensions with more score headroom sort first.
    27→    """
    28→    if not dimension_scores:
    29→        for item in items:
    30→            item["estimated_impact"] = 0.0
    31→        return
    32→
    33→    from desloppify.engine._scoring.results.health import compute_health_breakdown
    34→    from desloppify.engine._scoring.results.impact import get_dimension_for_detector
    35→
    36→    breakdown = compute_health_breakdown(dimension_scores)
    37→    entries = breakdown.get("entries", [])
    38→
    39→    # Build lookup: normalized dimension name -> {per_point, headroom}
    40→    dim_impact: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = {}
    41→    for entry in entries:
    42→        name = str(entry.get("name", "")).strip()
    43→        if not name:
    44→            continue
    45→        per_point = float(entry.get("overall_per_point", 0.0))
    46→        score = float(entry.get("score", 0.0))
    47→        headroom = 100.0 - score
    48→        dim_impact[name.lower()] = {"per_point": per_point, "headroom": headroom}
    49→
    50→    for item in items:
    51→        impact = _compute_item_impact(item, dim_impact, get_dimension_for_detector)
    52→        item["estimated_impact"] = impact
    53→
    54→
    55→def _compute_item_impact(
    56→    item: dict,
    57→    dim_impact: dict[str, dict[str, float]],
    58→    get_dimension_for_detector,
    59→) -> float:
    60→    """Compute impact value for a single queue item."""
    61→    kind = item.get("kind", "finding")
    62→
    63→    # Subjective items (synthetic dimensions or subjective findings):
    64→    # look up by detail.dimension_name
    65→    if kind == "subjective_dimension" or item.get("is_subjective"):
    66→        dim_name = detail_dict(item).get("dimension_name", "")
    67→        entry = dim_impact.get(dim_name.lower())
    68→        if entry:
    69→            return entry["per_point"] * entry["headroom"]
    70→        return 0.0
    71→
    72→    # Mechanical findings: use detector -> dimension mapping
    73→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
    74→    if detector:
    75→        dimension = get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
    76→        if dimension:
    77→            entry = dim_impact.get(dimension.name.lower())
    78→            if entry:
    79→                return entry["per_point"] * entry["headroom"]
    80→
    81→    return 0.0
    82→
    83→
    84→def subjective_score_value(item: dict) -> float:
    85→    if item.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension":
    86→        detail = detail_dict(item)
    87→        return float(detail.get("strict_score", item.get("subjective_score", 100.0)))
    88→    return float(item.get("subjective_score", 100.0))
    89→
    90→
    91→def build_finding_items(
    92→    state: dict,
    93→    *,
    94→    scan_path: str | None,

    97→    chronic: bool,
    98→) -> list[dict]:
    99→    scoped = path_scoped_findings(state.get("findings", {}), scan_path)
   100→    subjective_scores = subjective_strict_scores(state)
   101→    out: list[dict] = []
   102→
   103→    for finding_id, finding in scoped.items():
   104→        if finding.get("suppressed"):
   105→            continue
   106→        if not status_matches(finding.get("status", "open"), status_filter):
   107→            continue
   108→        if chronic and not (
   109→            finding.get("status") == "open" and finding.get("reopen_count", 0) >= 2
   110→        ):
   111→            continue
   112→
   113→        item = dict(finding)
   114→        item["id"] = finding_id
   115→        item["kind"] = "finding"
   116→        item["is_review"] = is_review_finding(item)
   117→        item["is_subjective"] = is_subjective_finding(item)
   118→        item["review_weight"] = (
   119→            review_finding_weight(item) if item["is_review"] else None
   120→        )
   121→        subjective_score = None
   122→        if item["is_subjective"]:
   123→            detail = detail_dict(finding)
   124→            dim_name = detail.get("dimension_name", "")
   125→            dim_key = detail.get("dimension", "") or slugify(dim_name)
   126→            subjective_score = subjective_scores.get(

   128→            )
   129→        item["subjective_score"] = subjective_score
   130→        supported_fixers = supported_fixers_for_item(state, item)
   131→        item["primary_command"] = primary_command_for_finding(
   132→            item,
   133→            supported_fixers=supported_fixers,
   134→        )
   135→
   136→        if not scope_matches(item, scope):
   137→            continue
   138→        out.append(item)
   139→
   140→    return out

   143→def item_sort_key(item: dict) -> tuple:
   144→    kind = item.get("kind", "finding")
   145→
   146→    # Initial-review subjective items: highest priority (tier -3)
   147→    if kind == "subjective_dimension" and item.get("initial_review"):
   148→        return (-3, 0, subjective_score_value(item), item.get("id", ""))
   149→
   150→    # Triage stage items: tier -2, stage order, blocked after unblocked
   151→    if kind == "workflow_stage":
   152→        blocked_penalty = 1 if item.get("is_blocked") else 0
   153→        stage_index = int(item.get("stage_index", 0))
   154→        return (-2, blocked_penalty, stage_index, item.get("id", ""))
   155→
   156→    # Workflow action items (e.g. create-plan): tier -1
   157→    if kind == "workflow_action":
   158→        return (-1, 0, 0, item.get("id", ""))
   159→
   160→    if kind == "cluster":
   161→        # Clusters sort before individual findings, ordered by action type
   162→        action_pri = ACTION_TYPE_PRIORITY.get(
   163→            item.get("action_type", "manual_fix"), 3
   164→        )
   165→        return (
   166→            0,
   167→            action_pri,
   168→            -int(item.get("member_count", 0)),
   169→            item.get("id", ""),
   170→        )
   171→
   172→    impact = item.get("estimated_impact", 0.0)
   173→
   174→    if kind == "subjective_dimension" or item.get("is_subjective"):
   175→        return (
   176→            1,

   274→def group_queue_items(items: list[dict], group: str) -> dict[str, list[dict]]:

   276→    grouped: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}

   282→        elif group == "cluster":

   284→            key = plan_cluster["name"] if isinstance(plan_cluster, dict) else "(unclustered)"
   285→        else:

   287→        grouped.setdefault(key, []).append(item)

   258→def render_terminal_items(
   259→    items: list[dict],
   260→    dim_scores: dict,
   261→    findings_scoped: dict,
   262→    *,
   263→    group: str,
   264→    explain: bool,
   265→    potentials: dict | None = None,
   266→    plan: dict | None = None,
   267→    cluster_filter: str | None = None,
   268→) -> None:
   269→    # Show focus header if plan has active cluster
   270→    if plan and plan.get("active_cluster"):
   271→        cluster_name = plan["active_cluster"]
   272→        clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   273→        cluster_data = clusters.get(cluster_name, {})
   274→        total = len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   275→        print(colorize(f"\n  Focused on: {cluster_name} ({len(items)} of {total} remaining)", "cyan"))
   276→
   277→    if group != "item":
   278→        _render_grouped(items, group)
   279→        return
   280→
   281→    # Detect cluster drill-in: multiple items with cluster focus active
   282→    is_cluster_drill = len(items) > 1 and (
   283→        cluster_filter or (plan and plan.get("active_cluster"))
   284→    )
   285→
   286→    for idx, item in enumerate(items):
   287→        if idx > 0:
   288→            print()
   289→        # Full card for first item, compact for rest in cluster drill-in
   290→        if is_cluster_drill and idx > 0:
   291→            _render_compact_item(item, idx, len(items))
   292→            continue
   293→        queue_pos = item.get("queue_position")
   294→        if queue_pos and len(items) > 1:
   295→            label = f"  [#{queue_pos}]"
   296→        elif len(items) > 1:
   297→            label = f"  [{idx + 1}/{len(items)}]"
   298→        else:
   299→            pos_str = f"  (#{ queue_pos} in queue)" if queue_pos else ""
   300→            label = f"  Next item{pos_str}"
   301→        print(colorize(label, "bold"))
   302→        _render_item(item, dim_scores, findings_scoped, explain=explain, potentials=potentials)
   303→
   304→
   305→def render_single_item_resolution_hint(items: list[dict]) -> None:
   306→    if len(items) != 1:
   307→        return
   308→    kind = items[0].get("kind", "finding")
   309→    if kind in ("cluster", "workflow_stage", "workflow_action"):
   310→        return  # These kinds have their own resolution hints
   311→    if kind != "finding":
   312→        return
   313→    item = items[0]
   314→    detector_name = item.get("detector", "")
   315→    if detector_name == "subjective_review":
   316→        print(colorize("\n  Review with:", "dim"))
   317→        primary = item.get(
   318→            "primary_command", "desloppify show subjective"
   319→        )
   320→        print(f"    {primary}")
   321→        if is_holistic_subjective_finding(item):
   322→            print("    desloppify review --prepare")
   323→        return
   324→
   325→    primary = item.get("primary_command", "")
   326→    if is_auto_fix_command(primary):
   327→        print(colorize("\n  Fix with:", "dim"))
   328→        print(f"    {primary}")
   329→        print(colorize("  Or resolve individually:", "dim"))
   330→    else:
   331→        print(colorize("\n  Resolve with:", "dim"))
   332→
   333→    print(
   334→        f'    desloppify plan done "{item["id"]}" --note "<what you did>" --confirm'
   335→    )
   336→    print(
   337→        f'    desloppify plan skip --permanent "{item["id"]}" --note "<why>" '
   338→        f'--attest "{ATTEST_EXAMPLE}"'
   339→    )

   342→def render_followup_nudges(
   343→    state: dict,
   344→    dim_scores: dict,
   345→    findings_scoped: dict,
   346→    *,
   347→    strict_score: float | None,
   348→    target_strict_score: float,
   349→    queue_total: int = 0,
   350→    plan_start_strict: float | None = None,
   351→    breakdown: "QueueBreakdown | None" = None,
   352→) -> None:
   353→    from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.queue_progress import (
   354→        format_queue_block,
   355→    )
   356→
   357→    subjective_threshold = target_strict_score
   358→    subjective_entries = scorecard_subjective(state, dim_scores)
   359→    followup = build_subjective_followup(
   360→        state,
   361→        subjective_entries,
   362→        threshold=subjective_threshold,
   363→        max_quality_items=3,
   364→        max_integrity_items=5,
   365→    )
   366→    unassessed_subjective = unassessed_subjective_dimensions(dim_scores)
   367→    # Show frozen plan-start score + queue block when in an active cycle
   368→    if queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is not None and breakdown is not None:
   369→        frozen = plan_start_strict
   370→        block = format_queue_block(breakdown, frozen_score=frozen)
   371→        print()
   372→        for text, style in block:
   373→            print(colorize(text, style))
   374→        print(colorize(
   375→            "  Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   376→            "dim",
   377→        ))
   378→    elif queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is not None:
   379→        print(
   380→            colorize(
   381→                f"\n  Score (frozen at plan start): strict {plan_start_strict:.1f}/100",
   382→                "cyan",
   383→            )
   384→        )
   385→        print(
   386→            colorize(
   387→                f"  Queue: {queue_total} item{'s' if queue_total != 1 else ''}"
   388→                " remaining. Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   389→                "dim",
   390→            )
   391→        )
   392→    elif strict_score is not None:
   393→        gap = round(float(target_strict_score) - float(strict_score), 1)
   394→        if gap > 0:
   395→            print(
   396→                colorize(
   397→                    f"\n  North star: strict {strict_score:.1f}/100 → target {target_strict_score:.1f} (+{gap:.1f} needed)",
   398→                    "cyan",
   399→                )
   400→            )
   401→        else:
   402→            print(
   403→                colorize(
   404→                    f"\n  North star: strict {strict_score:.1f}/100 meets target {target_strict_score:.1f}",
   405→                    "green",
   406→                )
   407→            )
   408→    # Show queue block after north star when no frozen score
   409→    if breakdown is not None and queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is None:
   410→        block = format_queue_block(breakdown)
   411→        for text, style in block:
   412→            print(colorize(text, style))
   413→
   414→    # Subjective bottleneck banner — only shown when the objective queue is
   415→    # clear.  While objective items remain, the queue is the single authority
   416→    # on what to work on next; no need to distract with subjective advice.
   417→    _objective_remaining = max(
   418→        0,
   419→        (breakdown.queue_total - breakdown.subjective) if breakdown else queue_total,
   420→    )
   421→    if strict_score is not None and dim_scores and _objective_remaining <= 0:
   422→        try:
   423→            health_breakdown = compute_health_breakdown(dim_scores)
   424→            subjective_drag = sum(
   425→                float(e.get("overall_drag", 0) or 0)
   426→                for e in health_breakdown.get("entries", [])
   427→                if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("component") == "subjective"
   428→            )
   429→            mechanical_drag = sum(
   430→                float(e.get("overall_drag", 0) or 0)
   431→                for e in health_breakdown.get("entries", [])
   432→                if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("component") != "subjective"
   433→            )
   434→            if subjective_drag > mechanical_drag and subjective_drag > 5.0:
   435→                print(colorize(
   436→                    f"\n  Subjective dimensions are the main bottleneck "
   437→                    f"(-{subjective_drag:.0f} pts vs -{mechanical_drag:.0f} pts mechanical).",
   438→                    "yellow",
   439→                ))
   440→                print(colorize(
   441→                    "  Code fixes alone won't close the gap — run "
   442→                    "`desloppify review --run-batches --runner codex --parallel --scan-after-import` "
   443→                    "to re-score.",
   444→                    "yellow",
   445→                ))
   446→        except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
   447→            log(f"  subjective bottleneck banner skipped: {exc}")
   448→
   449→    # Integrity penalty/warn lines preserved (anti-gaming safeguard, must remain visible).
   450→    for style, message in followup.integrity_lines:
   451→        print(colorize(f"\n  {message}", style))
   452→
   453→    # Rescan nudge after structural work
   454→    if queue_total > 10:
   455→        print(colorize(
   456→            "\n  Tip: after structural fixes (splitting files, moving code), rescan to "
   457→            "let cascade effects settle: `desloppify scan --path .`",
   458→            "dim",
   459→        ))
   460→
   461→    # Collapsed subjective summary.
   462→    coverage_open, _coverage_reasons, _holistic_reasons = subjective_coverage_breakdown(
   463→        findings_scoped
   464→    )
   465→    parts: list[str] = []
   466→    low_dims = len(followup.low_assessed)
   467→    unassessed_count = len(unassessed_subjective)
   468→    stale_count = sum(1 for e in subjective_entries if e.get("stale"))
   469→    open_review = [
   470→        f for f in findings_scoped.values()
   471→        if f.get("status") == "open" and f.get("detector") == "review"
   472→    ]
   473→    if low_dims:
   474→        parts.append(f"{low_dims} dimension{'s' if low_dims != 1 else ''} below target")
   475→    if stale_count:
   476→        parts.append(f"{stale_count} stale")
   477→    if unassessed_count:
   478→        parts.append(f"{unassessed_count} unassessed")
   479→    if len(open_review):
   480→        parts.append(f"{len(open_review)} review finding{'s' if len(open_review) != 1 else ''} open")
   481→    if coverage_open > 0:
   482→        parts.append(f"{coverage_open} file{'s' if coverage_open != 1 else ''} need review")
   483→
   484→    if parts:
   485→        print(colorize(f"\n  Subjective: {', '.join(parts)}.", "cyan"))
   486→        print(colorize("  Run `desloppify show subjective` for details.", "dim"))
   487→
   488→

     8→def new_item_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:

    23→def apply_plan_order(
    24→    items: list[dict],
    25→    plan: dict,
    26→    *,
    27→    include_skipped: bool = False,
    28→    cluster: str | None = None,
    29→    new_ids: set[str] | None = None,
    30→) -> list[dict]:
    31→    """Reorder items according to the living plan."""
    32→    queue_order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
    33→    skipped_map: dict = plan.get("skipped", {})
    34→    skipped_ids: set[str] = set(skipped_map.keys())
    35→    overrides: dict = plan.get("overrides", {})
    36→    clusters: dict = plan.get("clusters", {})
    37→    active_cluster = plan.get("active_cluster")

    39→    by_id: dict[str, dict] = {}
    40→    for item in items:
    41→        by_id[item["id"]] = item
    42→
    43→    for item_id, item in by_id.items():
    44→        override = overrides.get(item_id, {})
    45→        if override.get("description"):
    46→            item["plan_description"] = override["description"]
    47→        if override.get("note"):
    48→            item["plan_note"] = override["note"]
    49→        if override.get("cluster"):
    50→            cluster_name = override["cluster"]
    51→            cluster_data = clusters.get(cluster_name, {})
    52→            item["plan_cluster"] = {
    53→                "name": cluster_name,
    54→                "description": cluster_data.get("description"),
    55→                "total_items": len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", [])),
    56→            }
    57→
    58→    ordered: list[dict] = []
    59→    ordered_ids: set[str] = set()
    60→    for finding_id in queue_order:
    61→        if finding_id in by_id and finding_id not in skipped_ids:
    62→            ordered.append(by_id[finding_id])
    63→            ordered_ids.add(finding_id)
    64→
    65→    skipped_items: list[dict] = []
    66→    remaining_existing: list[dict] = []
    67→    remaining_new: list[dict] = []
    68→    _new = new_ids or set()
    69→    for item in items:
    70→        item_id = item["id"]
    71→        if item_id in ordered_ids:
    72→            continue
    73→        if item_id in skipped_ids:
    74→            skipped_items.append(item)

    77→        else:

    82→    # Triage stage IDs can appear in queue_order, so plan ordering may

    85→    stage_entries = [

    95→            ),
    96→        )
    97→        for (idx, _), replacement in zip(stage_entries, sorted_stages):
    98→            result[idx] = replacement
    99→
   100→    if include_skipped:

   123→def action_type_for_detector(detector: str) -> str:
   124→    """Look up the action_type for a detector from the registry."""
   125→    try:
   126→        from desloppify.core.registry import DETECTORS
   127→
   128→        meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
   129→        if meta:
   130→            return meta.action_type
   131→    except ImportError as exc:
   132→        _ = exc
   133→    return "manual_fix"

   135→
   136→def _build_cluster_meta(
   137→    cluster_name: str, members: list[dict], cluster_data: dict
   138→) -> dict:
   139→    """Build a cluster meta-item from its member items."""
   140→    detector = members[0].get("detector", "") if members else ""
   141→    action = cluster_data.get("action") or ""
   142→    if "desloppify fix" in action:
   143→        action_type = "auto_fix"
   144→    elif "desloppify move" in action:
   145→        action_type = "reorganize"
   146→    else:
   147→        action_type = action_type_for_detector(detector)
   148→        if action_type == "auto_fix" and "desloppify fix" not in action:
   149→            action_type = "refactor"
   150→
   151→    stored_desc = cluster_data.get("description") or ""
   152→    total_in_cluster = len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   153→    if stored_desc and total_in_cluster != len(members):
   154→        summary = stored_desc.replace(str(total_in_cluster), str(len(members)))
   155→    else:
   156→        summary = stored_desc or f"{len(members)} findings"
   157→
   158→    primary_command = cluster_data.get("action")
   159→    if not primary_command:
   160→        primary_command = f"desloppify next --cluster {cluster_name} --count 10"
   161→
   162→    estimated_impact = max(
   163→        (m.get("estimated_impact", 0.0) for m in members), default=0.0
   164→    )
   165→
   166→    return {
   167→        "id": cluster_name,
   168→        "kind": "cluster",
   169→        "action_type": action_type,
   170→        "summary": summary,
   171→        "members": members,
   172→        "member_count": len(members),
   173→        "primary_command": primary_command,
   174→        "cluster_name": cluster_name,
   175→        "cluster_auto": True,
   176→        "cluster_optional": bool(cluster_data.get("optional")),
   177→        "confidence": "high",
   178→        "detector": detector,
   179→        "file": "",
   180→        "estimated_impact": estimated_impact,
   181→    }
   182→
   183→
   184→def collapse_clusters(items: list[dict], plan: dict) -> list[dict]:
   185→    """Replace cluster member items with single cluster meta-items.
   186→
   187→    Walks the list in order: the first member of each collapsed cluster is
   188→    replaced with its meta-item, subsequent members are skipped.  This
   189→    preserves the ordering established by sort + plan-order.
   190→    """
   191→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   192→    if not clusters:
   193→        return items
   194→
   195→    fid_to_cluster: dict[str, str] = {}
   196→    for name, cluster in clusters.items():
   197→        if not cluster.get("auto"):
   198→            continue
   199→        for finding_id in cluster.get("finding_ids", []):
   200→            fid_to_cluster[finding_id] = name

1→"""Pattern → finding-ID resolution for plan commands."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from desloppify.engine._plan.schema import PlanModel
     6→from desloppify.state import StateModel, match_findings
     7→
     8→
     9→def resolve_ids_from_patterns(
    10→    state: StateModel,
    11→    patterns: list[str],
    12→    *,
    13→    plan: PlanModel | None = None,
    14→    status_filter: str = "open",
    15→) -> list[str]:
    16→    """Resolve one or more patterns to a deduplicated list of finding IDs.
    17→
    18→    When *plan* is provided, literal IDs that exist only in the plan
    19→    (e.g. ``subjective::*`` synthetic items) are included even if they
    20→    have no corresponding entry in ``state["findings"]``.
    21→    """
    22→    seen: set[str] = set()
    23→    result: list[str] = []
    24→
    25→    # Collect all plan IDs for literal-match fallback
    26→    plan_ids: set[str] = set()
    27→    if plan is not None:
    28→        plan_ids.update(plan.get("queue_order", []))
    29→        plan_ids.update(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
    30→        for cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).values():
    31→            plan_ids.update(cluster.get("finding_ids", []))
    32→
    33→    for pattern in patterns:
    34→        matches = match_findings(state, pattern, status_filter=status_filter)
    35→        if matches:
    36→            for finding in matches:
    37→                fid = finding["id"]
    38→                if fid not in seen:
    39→                    seen.add(fid)
    40→                    result.append(fid)
    41→        elif pattern in plan_ids and pattern not in seen:
    42→            # Literal plan ID (e.g. subjective::foo) not in state findings
    43→            seen.add(pattern)
    44→            result.append(pattern)
    45→        elif plan is not None and pattern in plan.get("clusters", {}):
    46→            # Cluster name → expand to member IDs
    47→            for fid in plan["clusters"][pattern].get("finding_ids", []):
    48→                if fid not in seen:
    49→                    seen.add(fid)
    50→                    result.append(fid)
    51→    return result
    52→
    53→
    54→__all__ = ["resolve_ids_from_patterns"]
    55→

    39→def cmd_resolve(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:

    42→    _validate_resolve_inputs(args, attestation)

    44→    if args.status == "fixed":

    46→        if not validate_note_length(note):
    47→            show_note_length_requirement(note)
    48→            return
    49→
    50→    state_file = state_path(args)
    51→    state = state_mod.load_state(state_file)
    52→
    53→    if _check_queue_order_guard(state, args.patterns, args.status):
    54→        return
    55→
    56→    if args.status == "fixed":
    57→        require_triage_current_or_exit(
    58→            state=state,
    59→            bypass=bool(getattr(args, "force_resolve", False)),
    60→            attest=getattr(args, "attest", "") or "",
    61→        )
    62→
    63→    _enforce_batch_wontfix_confirmation(
    64→        state,
    65→        args,
    66→        attestation=attestation,
    67→        resolve_all_patterns_fn=_resolve_all_patterns,
    68→    )
    69→    prev = _previous_score_snapshot(state)
    70→    prev_subjective_scores = {
    71→        str(dim): (coerce_assessment_score(payload) or 0.0)
    72→        for dim, payload in (state.get("subjective_assessments") or {}).items()
    73→        if isinstance(dim, str)
    74→    }
    75→
    76→    all_resolved = _resolve_all_patterns(state, args, attestation=attestation)
    77→    if not all_resolved:
    78→        status_label = "resolved" if args.status == "open" else "open"
    79→        print(colorize(f"No {status_label} findings matching: {' '.join(args.patterns)}", "yellow"))
    80→        return
    81→
    82→    _save_state_or_exit(state, state_file)
    83→

    99→            else:

   151→    """Regenerate automatic task clusters after scan merge."""
   152→    return bool(auto_cluster_findings(plan, state, target_strict=target_strict))

   154→
   155→def _seed_plan_start_scores(plan: dict[str, object], state: state_mod.StateModel) -> bool:
   156→    """Set plan_start_scores when beginning a new queue cycle."""
   157→    if plan.get("plan_start_scores"):
   158→        return False
   159→    scores = state_mod.score_snapshot(state)
   160→    if scores.strict is None:
   161→        return False
   162→    plan["plan_start_scores"] = {
   163→        "strict": scores.strict,
   164→        "overall": scores.overall,
   165→        "objective": scores.objective,
   166→        "verified": scores.verified,
   167→    }
   168→    return True

   170→
   171→def _clear_plan_start_scores_if_queue_empty(
   172→    state: state_mod.StateModel, plan: dict[str, object]
   173→) -> bool:
   174→    """Clear plan-start score snapshot once the queue is fully drained."""
   175→    if not plan.get("plan_start_scores"):
   176→        return False
   177→
   178→    try:
   179→        from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.queue_progress import plan_aware_queue_count
   180→
   181→        queue_empty = plan_aware_queue_count(state, plan) == 0
   182→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
   183→        logging.debug("Plan operation skipped: %s", exc)
   184→        return False
   185→    if not queue_empty:
   186→        return False
   187→    state["_plan_start_scores_for_reveal"] = dict(plan["plan_start_scores"])
   188→    plan["plan_start_scores"] = {}
   189→    return True

   191→
   192→def _reconcile_plan_post_scan(runtime: "ScanRuntime") -> None:
   193→    """Reconcile plan queue metadata and stale subjective review dimensions."""
   194→    try:
   195→        plan_path = runtime.state_path.parent / "plan.json" if runtime.state_path else None
   196→        plan = load_plan(plan_path)
   197→        dirty = False
   198→
   199→        if _apply_plan_reconciliation(plan, runtime.state, reconcile_plan_after_scan):
   200→            dirty = True
   201→
   202→        unscored_changed = _sync_unscored_dimensions(plan, runtime.state, sync_unscored_dimensions)
   203→        if unscored_changed:
   204→            dirty = True
   205→            append_log_entry(plan, "sync_unscored", actor="system",
   206→                             detail={"changes": True})
   207→
   208→        stale_changed = _sync_stale_dimensions(plan, runtime.state, sync_stale_dimensions)
   209→        if stale_changed:
   210→            dirty = True
   211→            append_log_entry(plan, "sync_stale", actor="system",
   212→                             detail={"changes": True})
   213→
   214→        from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.score import target_strict_score_from_config
   215→        _target_strict = target_strict_score_from_config(runtime.config, fallback=95.0)
   216→
   217→        auto_changed = _sync_auto_clusters(
   218→            plan, runtime.state, target_strict=_target_strict,
   219→        )
   220→        if auto_changed:
   221→            dirty = True
   222→            append_log_entry(plan, "auto_cluster", actor="system",
   223→                             detail={"changes": True})
   224→
   225→        triage_sync = sync_triage_needed(plan, runtime.state)
   226→        if triage_sync.changes:
   227→            dirty = True
   228→            if triage_sync.injected:
   229→                print(
   230→                    colorize(
   231→                        "  Plan: planning mode needed — review findings changed since last triage.",
   232→                        "cyan",
   233→                    )
   234→                )
   235→                append_log_entry(plan, "sync_triage", actor="system",
   236→                                 detail={"injected": True})
   237→
   238→        create_plan_sync = sync_create_plan_needed(plan, runtime.state)
   239→        if create_plan_sync.changes:
   240→            dirty = True
   241→            if create_plan_sync.injected:
   242→                print(
   243→                    colorize(
   244→                        "  Plan: reviews complete — `workflow::create-plan` queued.",
   245→                        "cyan",
   246→                    )
   247→                )
   248→                append_log_entry(plan, "sync_create_plan", actor="system",
   249→                                 detail={"injected": True})
   250→
   251→        seeded = _seed_plan_start_scores(plan, runtime.state)
   252→        if seeded:
   253→            dirty = True
   254→            append_log_entry(plan, "seed_start_scores", actor="system",
   255→                             detail={})
   256→        # Only clear scores that existed before this reconcile pass —
   257→        # never clear scores we just seeded in the same scan.
   258→        if not seeded and _clear_plan_start_scores_if_queue_empty(runtime.state, plan):
   259→            dirty = True
   260→            append_log_entry(plan, "clear_start_scores", actor="system",
   261→                             detail={})
   262→
   263→        if dirty:
   264→            save_plan(plan, plan_path)
   265→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
   266→        logging.debug("Plan operation skipped: %s", exc)
   267→

   354→def _configure_lang_runtime(
   355→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   356→    config: dict[str, object],
   357→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   358→    lang: LangRun | None,
   359→) -> LangRun | None:
   360→    """Populate runtime context and threshold overrides for a selected language."""
   361→    if not lang:
   362→        return None
   363→
   364→    lang_options = resolve_lang_runtime_options(args, lang)
   365→    lang_settings = resolve_lang_settings(config, lang)
   366→    runtime_lang = make_lang_run(
   367→        lang,
   368→        overrides=LangRunOverrides(
   369→            review_cache=state.get("review_cache", {}),
   370→            review_max_age_days=config.get("review_max_age_days", 30),
   371→            runtime_settings=lang_settings,
   372→            runtime_options=lang_options,
   373→            large_threshold_override=config.get("large_files_threshold", 0),
   374→            props_threshold_override=config.get("props_threshold", 0),
   375→        ),
   376→    )
   377→
   378→    lang_capabilities = _state_lang_capabilities(state)
   379→    lang_capabilities[runtime_lang.name] = {
   380→        "fixers": sorted(runtime_lang.fixers.keys()),
   381→        "typecheck_cmd": runtime_lang.typecheck_cmd,
   382→    }
   383→    return runtime_lang

   385→
   386→def _reset_subjective_assessments_for_scan_reset(
   387→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   388→    *,
   389→    lang_name: str | None = None,
   390→) -> int:
   391→    """Reset known subjective dimensions to 0 so the next scan starts fresh."""
   392→    assessments = _state_subjective_assessments(state)
   393→
   394→    reset_keys = {
   395→        key.strip()
   396→        for key in assessments
   397→        if isinstance(key, str) and key.strip()
   398→    }
   399→    reset_keys.update(_subjective_reset_dimensions(lang_name=lang_name))
   400→
   401→    now = state_mod.utc_now()
   402→    for key in sorted(reset_keys):
   403→        payload = assessments.get(key)
   404→        if isinstance(payload, dict):
   405→            payload["score"] = 0.0
   406→            payload["source"] = "scan_reset_subjective"
   407→            payload["assessed_at"] = now
   408→            payload["reset_by"] = "scan_reset_subjective"
   409→            payload["placeholder"] = True
   410→            payload.pop("integrity_penalty", None)
   411→            payload.pop("components", None)
   412→            payload.pop("component_scores", None)
   413→            continue
   414→        assessments[key] = {
   415→            "score": 0.0,
   416→            "source": "scan_reset_subjective",
   417→            "assessed_at": now,
   418→            "reset_by": "scan_reset_subjective",
   419→            "placeholder": True,
   420→        }
   421→    return len(reset_keys)
   422→
   423→
   424→def _expire_provisional_manual_override_assessments(
   425→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   426→) -> int:
   427→    """Expire provisional manual-override assessments at scan start."""
   428→    assessments = _state_subjective_assessments(state)
   429→
   430→    now = state_mod.utc_now()
   431→    expired = 0
   432→    for payload in assessments.values():
   433→        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
   434→            continue
   435→        if payload.get("provisional_override") is not True:
   436→            continue
   437→        payload["score"] = 0.0
   438→        payload["source"] = "manual_override_expired"
   439→        payload["assessed_at"] = now
   440→        payload["reset_by"] = "manual_override_expired"
   441→        payload["placeholder"] = True
   442→        payload.pop("provisional_override", None)
   443→        payload.pop("provisional_until_scan", None)
   444→        payload.pop("integrity_penalty", None)
   445→        payload.pop("components", None)
   446→        payload.pop("component_scores", None)
   447→        expired += 1
   448→    return expired

   451→def prepare_scan_runtime(args) -> ScanRuntime:
   452→    """Resolve state/config/language and apply scan-time runtime settings."""
   453→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   454→    state_file = runtime.state_path
   455→    state = runtime.state if isinstance(runtime.state, dict) else {}
   456→    state_mod.ensure_state_defaults(state)
   457→    path = Path(args.path)
   458→    config = runtime.config if isinstance(runtime.config, dict) else {}
   459→    lang_config = resolve_lang(args)
   460→    reset_subjective_count = 0
   461→    expired_manual_override_count = _expire_provisional_manual_override_assessments(
   462→        state
   463→    )
   464→    if getattr(args, "reset_subjective", False):
   465→        reset_subjective_count = _reset_subjective_assessments_for_scan_reset(
   466→            state,
   467→            lang_name=getattr(lang_config, "name", None),
   468→        )
   469→
   470→    include_slow = not getattr(args, "skip_slow", False)
   471→    profile = _resolve_scan_profile(getattr(args, "profile", None), lang_config)
   472→    effective_include_slow = _effective_include_slow(include_slow, profile)
   473→
   474→    lang = _configure_lang_runtime(args, config, state, lang_config)
   475→    coverage_warnings = _seed_runtime_coverage_warnings(lang)
   476→    zone_overrides_raw = config.get("zone_overrides")
   477→    zone_overrides = zone_overrides_raw if isinstance(zone_overrides_raw, dict) else None
   478→
   479→    return ScanRuntime(
   480→        args=args,
   481→        state_path=state_file,
   482→        state=state,
   483→        path=path,
   484→        config=config,
   485→        lang=lang,
   486→        lang_label=f" ({lang.name})" if lang else "",
   487→        profile=profile,
   488→        effective_include_slow=effective_include_slow,
   489→        zone_overrides=zone_overrides,
   490→        reset_subjective_count=reset_subjective_count,
   491→        expired_manual_override_count=expired_manual_override_count,
   492→        coverage_warnings=coverage_warnings,
   493→    )

   496→def _augment_with_stale_exclusion_findings(
   497→    findings: list[dict[str, Any]],
   498→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   499→) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
   500→    """Append stale exclude findings when excluded dirs are unreferenced."""
   501→    extra_exclusions = get_exclusions()
   502→    if not (extra_exclusions and runtime.lang and runtime.lang.file_finder):
   503→        return findings
   504→
   505→    scanned_files = runtime.lang.file_finder(runtime.path)
   506→    stale = _audit_excluded_dirs(
   507→        extra_exclusions, scanned_files, PROJECT_ROOT
   508→    )
   509→    if not stale:
   510→        return findings
   511→
   512→    augmented = list(findings)
   513→    augmented.extend(stale)
   514→    for stale_finding in stale:
   515→        print(colorize(f"  ℹ {stale_finding['summary']}", "dim"))
   516→    return augmented

   524→) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], int]:

   526→    return _augment_stale_wontfix_impl(

   535→def run_scan_generation(
   536→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   537→) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, object], dict[str, object] | None]:
   538→    """Run detector pipeline and return findings, potentials, and codebase metrics."""
   539→    enable_file_cache()
   540→    enable_parse_cache()
   541→    try:
   542→        findings, potentials = plan_mod.generate_findings(
   543→            runtime.path,
   544→            lang=runtime.lang,
   545→            options=PlanScanOptions(
   546→                include_slow=runtime.effective_include_slow,
   547→                zone_overrides=runtime.zone_overrides,
   548→                profile=runtime.profile,
   549→            ),
   550→        )
   551→    finally:
   552→        disable_parse_cache()
   553→        disable_file_cache()
   554→
   555→    codebase_metrics = _collect_codebase_metrics(runtime.lang, runtime.path)
   556→    _warn_explicit_lang_with_no_files(
   557→        runtime.args, runtime.lang, runtime.path, codebase_metrics
   558→    )
   559→    findings = _augment_with_stale_exclusion_findings(findings, runtime)
   560→    decay_scans = _coerce_int(
   561→        runtime.config.get("wontfix_decay_scans"),
   562→        default=_WONTFIX_DECAY_SCANS_DEFAULT,
   563→    )
   564→    findings, monitored_wontfix = _augment_with_stale_wontfix_findings(
   565→        findings,
   566→        runtime,
   567→        decay_scans=max(decay_scans, 0),
   568→    )
   569→    potentials["stale_wontfix"] = monitored_wontfix
   570→    return findings, potentials, codebase_metrics
   571→
   572→
   573→def merge_scan_results(
   574→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   575→    findings: list[dict[str, Any]],
   576→    potentials: dict[str, object],
   577→    codebase_metrics: dict[str, object] | None,
   578→) -> ScanMergeResult:
   579→    """Merge findings into persistent state and return diff + previous score snapshot."""
   580→    scan_path_rel = rel(str(runtime.path))
   581→    prev_scan_path = runtime.state.get("scan_path")
   582→    path_changed = prev_scan_path is not None and prev_scan_path != scan_path_rel
   583→
   584→    if not path_changed:
   585→        prev = state_mod.score_snapshot(runtime.state)
   586→    else:
   587→        prev = state_mod.ScoreSnapshot(None, None, None, None)
   588→    prev_dim_scores = (
   589→        runtime.state.get("dimension_scores", {}) if not path_changed else {}
   590→    )
   591→
   592→    if runtime.lang and runtime.lang.zone_map is not None:
   593→        runtime.state["zone_distribution"] = runtime.lang.zone_map.counts()
   594→    _persist_scan_coverage(runtime.state, runtime.lang)
   595→
   596→    target_score = target_strict_score_from_config(runtime.config, fallback=95.0)
   597→
   598→    diff = state_mod.merge_scan(
   599→        runtime.state,
   600→        findings,
   601→        options=state_mod.MergeScanOptions(
   602→            lang=runtime.lang.name if runtime.lang else None,
   603→            scan_path=scan_path_rel,
   604→            force_resolve=getattr(runtime.args, "force_resolve", False),
   605→            exclude=get_exclusions(),
   606→            potentials=potentials,
   607→            codebase_metrics=codebase_metrics,
   608→            include_slow=runtime.effective_include_slow,
   609→            ignore=runtime.config.get("ignore", []),
   610→            subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   611→        ),
   612→    )
   613→
   614→    issues_mod.expire_stale_holistic(
   615→        runtime.state, runtime.config.get("holistic_max_age_days", 30)
   616→    )
   617→    state_mod.save_state(
   618→        runtime.state,
   619→        runtime.state_path,
   620→        subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   621→    )
   622→
   623→    _clear_needs_rescan_flag(runtime.config)
   624→    _reconcile_plan_post_scan(runtime)
   625→
   626→    return ScanMergeResult(
   627→        diff=diff,
   628→        prev_overall=prev.overall,
   629→        prev_objective=prev.objective,
   630→        prev_strict=prev.strict,
   631→        prev_verified=prev.verified,
   632→        prev_dim_scores=prev_dim_scores,
   633→    )
   634→
   635→
   636→def resolve_noise_snapshot(
   637→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   638→    config: dict[str, object],
   639→) -> ScanNoiseSnapshot:
   640→    """Resolve noise budget settings and hidden finding counters."""
   641→    noise_budget, global_noise_budget, budget_warning = (
   642→        state_mod.resolve_finding_noise_settings(config)
   643→    )
   644→    findings_by_id = _state_findings(state)
   645→    open_findings = [
   646→        finding
   647→        for finding in state_mod.path_scoped_findings(
   648→            findings_by_id, state.get("scan_path")
   649→        ).values()
   650→        if finding.get("status") == "open"
   651→    ]
   652→    _, hidden_by_detector = state_mod.apply_finding_noise_budget(
   653→        open_findings,
   654→        budget=noise_budget,
   655→        global_budget=global_noise_budget,
   656→    )
   657→
   658→    return ScanNoiseSnapshot(
   659→        noise_budget=noise_budget,
   660→        global_noise_budget=global_noise_budget,
   661→        budget_warning=budget_warning,
   662→        hidden_by_detector=hidden_by_detector,
   663→        hidden_total=sum(hidden_by_detector.values()),
   664→    )
   665→
   666→
   667→def persist_reminder_history(
   668→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   669→    narrative: dict[str, object],
   670→) -> None:
   671→    """Persist reminder history emitted by narrative computation."""
   672→    if not (narrative and "reminder_history" in narrative):
   673→        return
   674→
   675→    runtime.state["reminder_history"] = narrative["reminder_history"]
   676→    target_score = target_strict_score_from_config(runtime.config, fallback=95.0)
   677→    state_mod.save_state(
   678→        runtime.state,
   679→        runtime.state_path,
   680→        subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   681→    )
   682→

    19→_MIN_CLUSTER_SIZE = 2
    20→_STALE_KEY = "subjective::stale"
    21→_STALE_NAME = "auto/stale-review"
    22→_UNSCORED_KEY = "subjective::unscored"
    23→_UNSCORED_NAME = "auto/initial-review"
    24→_UNDER_TARGET_KEY = "subjective::under-target"
    25→_UNDER_TARGET_NAME = "auto/under-target-review"

    29→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    30→# Grouping key computation
    31→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    32→
    33→def _extract_subtype(finding: dict) -> str | None:
    34→    """Extract the subtype/kind from a finding.
    35→
    36→    Checks detail.kind first, then falls back to parsing the finding ID
    37→    (format: ``detector::file::subtype`` or ``detector::file::symbol::subtype``).
    38→    """
    39→    detail = finding.get("detail") or {}
    40→    kind = detail.get("kind")
    41→    if kind:
    42→        return kind
    43→
    44→    # Parse from finding ID — third segment is often the subtype
    45→    fid = finding.get("id", "")
    46→    parts = fid.split("::")
    47→    if len(parts) >= 3:
    48→        # For IDs like smells::file.py::silent_except, the subtype is parts[2]
    49→        # For IDs like dict_keys::file.py::key::phantom_read, subtype is last part
    50→        candidate = parts[-1]
    51→        # Skip if it looks like a file path or symbol name (contains / or .)
    52→        if "/" not in candidate and "." not in candidate:
    53→            return candidate
    54→    return None
    55→
    56→
    57→def _grouping_key(finding: dict, meta: DetectorMeta | None) -> str | None:
    58→    """Compute a deterministic grouping key for a finding.
    59→
    60→    Returns None if the finding should not be auto-clustered.
    61→    """
    62→    detector = finding.get("detector", "")
    63→
    64→    if meta is None:
    65→        # Unknown detector — group by detector name
    66→        return f"detector::{detector}"
    67→
    68→    # Review findings → group by dimension
    69→    if detector in ("review", "subjective_review"):
    70→        detail = finding.get("detail") or {}
    71→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", "")
    72→        if dimension:
    73→            return f"review::{dimension}"
    74→        return f"detector::{detector}"
    75→
    76→    # Per-file detectors (structural, responsibility_cohesion)
    77→    if meta.needs_judgment and detector in (
    78→        "structural", "responsibility_cohesion",
    79→    ):
    80→        file = finding.get("file", "")
    81→        if file:
    82→            basename = os.path.basename(file)
    83→            return f"file::{detector}::{basename}"
    84→
    85→    # Needs-judgment detectors — group by subtype when available
    86→    if meta.needs_judgment:
    87→        subtype = _extract_subtype(finding)
    88→        if subtype:
    89→            return f"typed::{detector}::{subtype}"
    90→
    91→    # Pure auto-fix (no judgment needed) → all findings by detector
    92→    if meta.action_type == "auto_fix" and not meta.needs_judgment:
    93→        return f"auto::{detector}"
    94→
    95→    # Everything else → by detector
    96→    return f"detector::{detector}"
    97→
    98→
    99→def _cluster_name_from_key(key: str) -> str:
   100→    """Convert a grouping key to a cluster name with auto/ prefix."""
   101→    # auto::unused → auto/unused
   102→    # typed::dict_keys::phantom_read → auto/dict_keys-phantom_read
   103→    # file::structural::big_file.py → auto/structural-big_file.py
   104→    # review::abstraction_fitness → auto/review-abstraction_fitness
   105→    # detector::security → auto/security
   106→    parts = key.split("::")
   107→    if len(parts) == 2:
   108→        prefix_type = parts[0]
   109→        # For review keys, keep the prefix for clarity
   110→        if prefix_type == "review":
   111→            return f"{AUTO_PREFIX}review-{parts[1]}"
   112→        return f"{AUTO_PREFIX}{parts[1]}"
   113→    if len(parts) == 3:
   114→        return f"{AUTO_PREFIX}{parts[1]}-{parts[2]}"
   115→    return f"{AUTO_PREFIX}{key.replace('::', '-')}"
   116→
   117→
   118→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   119→# Description and action generation
   120→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   121→
   122→def _generate_description(
   123→    cluster_name: str,
   124→    members: list[dict],
   125→    meta: DetectorMeta | None,
   126→    subtype: str | None,
   127→) -> str:
   128→    """Generate a human-readable cluster description."""
   129→    count = len(members)
   130→    detector = members[0].get("detector", "") if members else ""
   131→
   132→    if detector in ("review", "subjective_review"):
   133→        detail = (members[0].get("detail") or {}) if members else {}
   134→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", detector)
   135→        return f"Address {count} {dimension} review findings"
   136→
   137→    if detector == "structural":
   138→        files = {os.path.basename(m.get("file", "")) for m in members}
   139→        if len(files) == 1:
   140→            return f"Decompose {next(iter(files))}"
   141→        return f"Decompose {count} large files"
   142→
   143→    display = meta.display if meta else detector
   144→    if subtype:
   145→        label = subtype.replace("_", " ")
   146→        return f"Fix {count} {label} issues"
   147→
   148→    if meta and meta.action_type == "auto_fix" and not meta.needs_judgment:
   149→        return f"Remove {count} {display} findings"
   150→
   151→    return f"Fix {count} {display} issues"
   152→
   153→
   154→def _subtype_has_fixer(meta: DetectorMeta, subtype: str | None) -> str | None:
   155→    """Check if a subtype maps to a specific fixer."""
   156→    if not meta.fixers or not subtype:
   157→        return None
   158→    # Convention: fixer name is subtype with _ replaced by -
   159→    fixer_name = subtype.replace("_", "-")
   160→    if fixer_name in meta.fixers:
   161→        return fixer_name
   162→    # Also check if subtype is a substring (e.g. "unused" matches "unused-imports")
   163→    for fixer in meta.fixers:
   164→        if subtype in fixer:
   165→            return fixer
   166→    return None
   167→
   168→
   169→def _strip_guidance_examples(guidance: str) -> str:
   170→    """Strip subtype-specific examples from guidance text.
   171→
   172→    Many guidance strings have format "verb — specific examples".
   173→    Strip after the dash to get the core action:
   174→      "fix code smells — dead useEffect, empty if chains" → "fix code smells"
   175→    """
   176→    if " — " in guidance:
   177→        return guidance.split(" — ", 1)[0].strip()
   178→    return guidance
   179→
   180→
   181→_ACTION_TYPE_TEMPLATES: dict[str, str] = {
   182→    "reorganize": "reorganize with desloppify move",
   183→    "refactor": "review and refactor each finding",
   184→    "manual_fix": "review and fix each finding",
   185→}
   186→
   187→
   188→def _generate_action(
   189→    meta: DetectorMeta | None,
   190→    subtype: str | None,
   191→) -> str:
   192→    """Generate an action string from detector metadata.
   193→
   194→    Always returns a non-empty string — every cluster gets an action.
   195→    """
   196→    if meta is None:
   197→        return "review and fix each finding"
   198→
   199→    # For detectors with subtypes, only suggest a fixer if the subtype matches
   200→    if subtype and meta.fixers:
   201→        matched_fixer = _subtype_has_fixer(meta, subtype)
   202→        if matched_fixer:
   203→            return f"desloppify fix {matched_fixer} --dry-run"
   204→    elif meta.action_type == "auto_fix" and meta.fixers and not meta.needs_judgment:
   205→        # Pure auto-fix detector, no subtypes
   206→        return f"desloppify fix {meta.fixers[0]} --dry-run"
   207→
   208→    if meta.tool == "move":
   209→        return "desloppify move"
   210→
   211→    # Guidance available — use it (strip examples for subtyped detectors)
   212→    if meta.guidance:
   213→        if subtype:
   214→            return _strip_guidance_examples(meta.guidance)
   215→        return meta.guidance
   216→
   217→    # Final fallback: action_type template
   218→    return _ACTION_TYPE_TEMPLATES.get(
   219→        meta.action_type, "review and fix each finding"
   220→    )

   223→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   224→# Repair
   225→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   226→
   227→def _repair_ghost_cluster_refs(plan: PlanModel, now: str) -> int:
   228→    """Clear override cluster refs that point to non-existent clusters."""
   229→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   230→    overrides = plan.get("overrides", {})
   231→    repaired = 0
   232→    for override in overrides.values():
   233→        cluster_name = override.get("cluster")
   234→        if cluster_name and cluster_name not in clusters:
   235→            override["cluster"] = None
   236→            override["updated_at"] = now
   237→            repaired += 1
   238→    return repaired
   239→
   240→
   241→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   242→# Shared create-or-update helper
   243→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   244→
   245→def _sync_auto_cluster(
   246→    plan: PlanModel,
   247→    clusters: dict,
   248→    existing_by_key: dict[str, str],
   249→    *,
   250→    cluster_key: str,
   251→    cluster_name: str,
   252→    member_ids: list[str],
   253→    description: str,
   254→    action: str,
   255→    now: str,
   256→    optional: bool = False,
   257→) -> int:
   258→    """Create or update an auto-cluster and sync its override entries.
   259→
   260→    Handles the common pattern: check if cluster exists by key, update
   261→    membership/metadata if changed, or create a new cluster.  Always syncs
   262→    override entries for all *member_ids*.
   263→
   264→    Returns 1 if a change was made, 0 otherwise.
   265→    """
   266→    changes = 0
   267→    existing_name = existing_by_key.get(cluster_key)
   268→    if existing_name and existing_name in clusters:
   269→        cluster = clusters[existing_name]
   270→        old_ids = set(cluster.get("finding_ids", []))
   271→        new_ids_set = set(member_ids)
   272→        if old_ids != new_ids_set or cluster.get("description") != description or cluster.get("action") != action:
   273→            cluster["finding_ids"] = list(member_ids)
   274→            cluster["description"] = description
   275→            cluster["action"] = action
   276→            cluster["updated_at"] = now
   277→            changes = 1
   278→    else:
   279→        new_cluster: Cluster = {
   280→            "name": cluster_name,
   281→            "description": description,
   282→            "finding_ids": list(member_ids),
   283→            "created_at": now,
   284→            "updated_at": now,
   285→            "auto": True,
   286→            "cluster_key": cluster_key,
   287→            "action": action,
   288→            "user_modified": False,
   289→        }
   290→        if optional:
   291→            new_cluster["optional"] = True
   292→        clusters[cluster_name] = new_cluster
   293→        existing_by_key[cluster_key] = cluster_name
   294→        changes = 1
   295→
   296→    # Sync overrides
   297→    overrides = plan.get("overrides", {})
   298→    current_name = existing_by_key.get(cluster_key, cluster_name)
   299→    for fid in member_ids:
   300→        if fid not in overrides:
   301→            overrides[fid] = {"finding_id": fid, "created_at": now}
   302→        overrides[fid]["cluster"] = current_name
   303→        overrides[fid]["updated_at"] = now
   304→
   305→    return changes
   306→

   308→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   309→# Main algorithm
   310→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   311→
   312→def auto_cluster_findings(
   313→    plan: PlanModel,
   314→    state: StateModel,
   315→    *,
   316→    target_strict: float = 95.0,
   317→) -> int:
   318→    """Regenerate auto-clusters from current open findings.
   319→
   320→    Returns count of changes made (clusters created, updated, or deleted).
   321→    """
   322→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   323→    changes = 0
   324→
   325→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   326→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   327→
   328→    # Set of finding IDs in manual (non-auto) clusters
   329→    manual_member_ids: set[str] = set()
   330→    for cluster in clusters.values():
   331→        if not cluster.get("auto"):
   332→            manual_member_ids.update(cluster.get("finding_ids", []))
   333→
   334→    # Collect open, non-suppressed findings and group by key
   335→    groups: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
   336→    finding_data: dict[str, dict] = {}
   337→    for fid, finding in findings.items():
   338→        if finding.get("status") != "open":
   339→            continue
   340→        if finding.get("suppressed"):
   341→            continue
   342→        if fid in manual_member_ids:
   343→            continue
   344→
   345→        detector = finding.get("detector", "")
   346→        meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
   347→        key = _grouping_key(finding, meta)
   348→        if key is None:
   349→            continue
   350→
   351→        groups[key].append(fid)
   352→        finding_data[fid] = finding
   353→
   354→    # Drop singleton groups
   355→    groups = {k: v for k, v in groups.items() if len(v) >= _MIN_CLUSTER_SIZE}
   356→
   357→    # Map existing auto-clusters by cluster_key
   358→    existing_by_key: dict[str, str] = {}  # cluster_key → cluster_name
   359→    for name, cluster in list(clusters.items()):
   360→        if cluster.get("auto"):
   361→            ck = cluster.get("cluster_key", "")
   362→            if ck:
   363→                existing_by_key[ck] = name
   364→
   365→    now = utc_now()
   366→    active_auto_keys: set[str] = set()
   367→
   368→    for key, member_ids in groups.items():
   369→        active_auto_keys.add(key)
   370→        cluster_name = _cluster_name_from_key(key)
   371→
   372→        # Representative finding for metadata
   373→        rep = finding_data.get(member_ids[0], {})
   374→        detector = rep.get("detector", "")
   375→        meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
   376→        members = [finding_data[fid] for fid in member_ids if fid in finding_data]
   377→
   378→        # Extract subtype from grouping key (typed::detector::subtype)
   379→        key_parts = key.split("::")
   380→        subtype = key_parts[2] if len(key_parts) >= 3 else None
   381→
   382→        description = _generate_description(cluster_name, members, meta, subtype)
   383→        action = _generate_action(meta, subtype)
   384→
   385→        # User-modified clusters: merge new members only, keep user edits
   386→        existing_name = existing_by_key.get(key)
   387→        if existing_name and existing_name in clusters:
   388→            cluster = clusters[existing_name]
   389→            if cluster.get("user_modified"):
   390→                existing_ids = set(cluster.get("finding_ids", []))
   391→                new_ids = [fid for fid in member_ids if fid not in existing_ids]
   392→                if new_ids:
   393→                    cluster["finding_ids"].extend(new_ids)
   394→                    cluster["updated_at"] = now
   395→                    changes += 1
   396→                # Still sync overrides for all members
   397→                overrides = plan.get("overrides", {})
   398→                for fid in member_ids:
   399→                    if fid not in overrides:
   400→                        overrides[fid] = {"finding_id": fid, "created_at": now}
   401→                    overrides[fid]["cluster"] = existing_name
   402→                    overrides[fid]["updated_at"] = now
   403→                continue
   404→
   405→        # Handle name collision (existing auto-cluster with different key)
   406→        if cluster_name in clusters and clusters[cluster_name].get("cluster_key") != key:
   407→            cluster_name = f"{cluster_name}-{len(member_ids)}"
   408→
   409→        changes += _sync_auto_cluster(
   410→            plan, clusters, existing_by_key,
   411→            cluster_key=key,
   412→            cluster_name=cluster_name,
   413→            member_ids=member_ids,
   414→            description=description,
   415→            action=action,
   416→            now=now,
   417→        )
   418→
   419→    # --- Subjective dimension clusters (unscored + stale) -------------------
   420→    all_subjective_ids = sorted(
   421→        fid for fid in plan.get("queue_order", [])
   422→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   423→    )
   424→    unscored_state_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   425→    unscored_queue_ids = sorted(
   426→        fid for fid in all_subjective_ids if fid in unscored_state_ids
   427→    )
   428→    stale_queue_ids = sorted(
   429→        fid for fid in all_subjective_ids if fid not in unscored_state_ids
   430→    )
   431→
   432→    # -- Initial review cluster (unscored, min size 1) ---------------------
   433→    if len(unscored_queue_ids) >= _MIN_UNSCORED_CLUSTER_SIZE:
   434→        active_auto_keys.add(_UNSCORED_KEY)
   435→        cli_keys = [fid.removeprefix(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX) for fid in unscored_queue_ids]
   436→        description = f"Initial review of {len(unscored_queue_ids)} unscored subjective dimensions"
   437→        action = f"desloppify review --prepare --dimensions {','.join(cli_keys)}"
   438→        changes += _sync_auto_cluster(
   439→            plan, clusters, existing_by_key,
   440→            cluster_key=_UNSCORED_KEY,
   441→            cluster_name=_UNSCORED_NAME,
   442→            member_ids=unscored_queue_ids,
   443→            description=description,
   444→            action=action,
   445→            now=now,
   446→        )
   447→
   448→    # -- Stale review cluster (previously scored, min size 2) --------------
   449→    if len(stale_queue_ids) >= _MIN_CLUSTER_SIZE:
   450→        active_auto_keys.add(_STALE_KEY)
   451→        cli_keys = [fid.removeprefix(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX) for fid in stale_queue_ids]
   452→        description = f"Re-review {len(stale_queue_ids)} stale subjective dimensions"
   453→        action = (
   454→            "desloppify review --prepare --dimensions "
   455→            + ",".join(cli_keys)
   456→            + " --force-review-rerun"
   457→        )
   458→        changes += _sync_auto_cluster(
   459→            plan, clusters, existing_by_key,
   460→            cluster_key=_STALE_KEY,
   461→            cluster_name=_STALE_NAME,
   462→            member_ids=stale_queue_ids,
   463→            description=description,
   464→            action=action,
   465→            now=now,
   466→        )
   467→
   468→    # -- Under-target review cluster (optional, current but below target) ----
   469→    # current_under_target_ids already excludes stale and unscored dims.
   470→    # Don't filter through all_subjective_ids — these IDs may not be in
   471→    # queue_order yet (no sync function adds them).  We inject them into
   472→    # queue_order below so they get proper positions.
   473→    under_target_ids = current_under_target_ids(state, target_strict=target_strict)
   474→    stale_state_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   475→    under_target_queue_ids = sorted(under_target_ids)
   476→
   477→    # Prune: remove IDs that were previously in the under-target cluster
   478→    # but are no longer under target (they've improved above threshold).
   479→    prev_ut_cluster = clusters.get(_UNDER_TARGET_NAME, {})
   480→    prev_ut_ids = set(prev_ut_cluster.get("finding_ids", []))
   481→    order = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   482→    _ut_prune = [
   483→        fid for fid in prev_ut_ids
   484→        if fid not in under_target_ids
   485→        and fid not in stale_state_ids
   486→        and fid not in unscored_state_ids
   487→        and fid in order
   488→    ]
   489→    for fid in _ut_prune:
   490→        order.remove(fid)
   491→        changes += 1
   492→    if len(under_target_queue_ids) >= _MIN_CLUSTER_SIZE:
   493→        active_auto_keys.add(_UNDER_TARGET_KEY)
   494→        cli_keys = [fid.removeprefix(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX) for fid in under_target_queue_ids]
   495→        description = (
   496→            f"Consider re-reviewing {len(under_target_queue_ids)} "
   497→            f"dimensions under target score"
   498→        )
   499→        action = (
   500→            "desloppify review --prepare --dimensions "
   501→            + ",".join(cli_keys)
   502→            + " --force-review-rerun"
   503→        )
   504→        changes += _sync_auto_cluster(
   505→            plan, clusters, existing_by_key,
   506→            [REDACTED],
   507→            cluster_name=_UNDER_TARGET_NAME,
   508→            member_ids=under_target_queue_ids,
   509→            description=description,
   510→            action=action,
   511→            now=now,
   512→            optional=True,
   513→        )
   514→
   515→        # Ensure under-target IDs are in queue_order (at the back)
   516→        order = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   517→        existing_order = set(order)
   518→        for fid in under_target_queue_ids:
   519→            if fid not in existing_order:
   520→                order.append(fid)
   521→
   522→    # Delete stale auto-clusters (no matching group, not user_modified)
   523→    for name in list(clusters.keys()):
   524→        cluster = clusters[name]
   525→        if not cluster.get("auto"):
   526→            continue
   527→        ck = cluster.get("cluster_key", "")
   528→        if ck in active_auto_keys:
   529→            continue
   530→        if cluster.get("user_modified"):
   531→            # Keep user-modified clusters but prune dead member IDs
   532→            alive = [fid for fid in cluster.get("finding_ids", [])
   533→                     if fid in findings and findings[fid].get("status") == "open"]
   534→            if alive:
   535→                if len(alive) != len(cluster.get("finding_ids", [])):
   536→                    cluster["finding_ids"] = alive
   537→                    cluster["updated_at"] = now
   538→                    changes += 1
   539→                continue
   540→            # All members gone — delete even if user_modified
   541→        # Delete stale cluster
   542→        del clusters[name]
   543→        # Clear cluster refs from overrides
   544→        for fid in cluster.get("finding_ids", []):
   545→            override = plan.get("overrides", {}).get(fid)
   546→            if override and override.get("cluster") == name:
   547→                override["cluster"] = None
   548→                override["updated_at"] = now
   549→        if plan.get("active_cluster") == name:
   550→            plan["active_cluster"] = None
   551→        changes += 1
   552→
   553→    # Repair any orphaned override cluster references from prior bugs
   554→    repaired = _repair_ghost_cluster_refs(plan, now)
   555→    changes += repaired
   556→
   557→    plan["updated"] = now
   558→    return changes
